propositions: A runaway read_file loop triggered the runaway guard correctly, but the truncated/un-banked criterion was not stamped with the insufficiency marker in _restamp_marker's echo branch (entry is None case), leaving a bare met=false indistinguishable from a genuine refutation.

reconcile_verdict derives evidence_sufficient=False on an insufficiency-only FAIL, but close_precheck and verify-completion verb route to exit 1 (hard block) instead of exit 11 (retryable) because they key only on verdict_obtainable=False.

The fix stamps evidence_sufficient=False on unbanked (truncated) met=false echoes and routes insufficiency-only FAILs through a shared completion_fail_returncode helper that returns exit 11 when evidence_sufficient=False or verdict_obtainable=False, preserving exit 1 for genuine refutations.
Genuine refutations (conclusive bank entry with no insufficiency marker) must remain bare met=false and hard-block (exit 1) so that real failures are not masked by the insufficiency routing.
The defect origin is commit 6b318ffaec4a (ticket 1d71-a76c-04f6-4642) which introduced _restamp_marker and evidence_sufficient but left both seams incomplete.
